hero.title: Maharishi Markandeshwar (Deemed to be University), Mullana
hero.summary: MM(DU)’s Faculty of Agriculture at Mullana offers undergraduate agriculture and master’s study in agronomy and entomology. Its 2026-27 information booklet states academic entry requirements, while a separate dated fee sheet distinguishes tuition from other academic charges and later-year increases.

overview.heading: Agriculture, agronomy and entomology at Mullana
paragraphs: The university’s agriculture pathway includes a four-year B.Sc. and two-year master’s degrees in agronomy and entomology. These courses serve different academic stages: a broad undergraduate foundation, crop-management specialisation and the study of agricultural insects. The 2026-27 information booklet specifies qualifying subjects and marks for each route.

The faculty’s self-study report identifies a teaching museum of agricultural tools, seeds and models, plus postgraduate laboratories and research plots. A May 2026 university account also records agricultural expert discussions and describes experimental farms. These sources support a practical learning context; they do not establish a typical graduate salary or a guaranteed appointment.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: The 2026-27 booklet gives the academic threshold for each agriculture course. The main course webpages did not expose usable application text during research, so a current selection notice and deadlines should be requested separately.
eligibility_points: B.Sc.: English plus the specified science/agriculture route and 50% aggregate, or 45% for SC/ST.
M.Sc. Agronomy: relevant agriculture bachelor’s qualification with 60%, or 50% SC/ST.
M.Sc. Entomology: Agriculture, Horticulture or Forestry bachelor’s qualification with 60%, or 50% SC/ST.

faqs.question: What are the undergraduate subjects required in 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The booklet requires five 10+2 subjects including English and the specified Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Mathematics or Agriculture route.

faqs.question: What is the published B.Sc. first-year academic total?
faqs.answer: The 2026-27 fee sheet gives INR 1,40,000; its INR 1,21,500 tuition component is only part of that total.

faqs.question: Does tuition stay fixed across four years?
faqs.answer: The fee sheet states a 7% annual tuition increase and separately prints later-year charges.

faqs.question: Can horticulture graduates apply for entomology?
faqs.answer: The 2026-27 booklet includes Agriculture, Horticulture and Forestry bachelor’s qualifications, with its stated marks threshold.

faqs.question: Are both master’s courses covered by the checked ICAR row?
faqs.answer: The audited Faculty of Agriculture row explicitly prints B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The master’s offerings do not expand that scope.
